Biyang Biyang Classic series browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Biyang OD-12 X-Drive Published on December 30, 2013 Biyang Classic series overdrive pedal Information The Biyang OD-12 X-Drive is a versatile, triple-mode overdrive pedal from the Biyang Classic Series, designed to deliver a wide range of dynamic, amp-like overdrive tones. Based around the legendary JRC4558 chip used in the classic overdrives of the 1970s, the OD-12 provides a warm, organic sound with detailed articulation and smooth clipping. It offers three distinct tonal modes, letting players easily switch between classic tube-style grit, brighter modern drive, and rounded, vintage warmth. Built with high-quality components and true bypass circuitry, the OD-12 delivers professional-grade tone and reliability at an accessible price point. It's suitable for a wide variety of styles, from blues and classic rock to modern fusion tones. Controls Drive: Adjusts the amount of overdrive and saturation. Lower settings offer subtle breakup and edge-of-clean tones, while higher settings provide rich, full-bodied distortion with smooth sustain. Tone: Shapes the brightness of the overdriven signal. Turning clockwise increases treble and clarity, while turning counterclockwise gives a darker, more rounded tone. Level: Controls the overall output volume of the pedal. Can be used to balance the signal level or boost the front end of an amplifier. Mode Switch: Three-position toggle for selecting tonal character. TS: Classic tube-style midrange focus, similar to a vintage overdrive circuit with smooth, compressed tone. Bright: Emphasizes high frequencies for a crisp, cutting tone that enhances clarity and presence. Warm: Produces a deeper, thicker tone with softer treble response, ideal for rhythm playing and vintage-style overdrive. Construction and Features Circuit Type: Analog overdrive circuit based on the JRC4558 op-amp Bypass Type: True bypass Components: German WIMA capacitors, high-precision resistors, and sealed, dustproof potentiometers Chip Options: Includes interchangeable op-amps (accessible via back plate) for tonal experimentation Enclosure: Sturdy metal casing built for reliability and stage use Power Supply: 9V battery (behind back plate) or 9V DC power adapter (center negative) Technical Specif
